{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - always add 0.1 to 0.3 for accurate alignment",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.33) accelerates price convergence to forecasts, negative slows it",
    "When prices are rising rapidly, model underforecasts by 0.3-0.5 compared to stable periods",
    "Mean reversion effect: forecasts overshoot when prices deviate far from historical mean",
    "High sentiment volatility (changing quickly) reduces forecast accuracy by 20-30%",
    "Latest price points have highest influence - older history weight decays rapidly",
    "When sentiment flips from negative to positive, expect 0.1-0.2 faster convergence than sentiment staying positive"
] }
